name: CORTICEIRA AMORIM SA
summary: CORTICEIRA AMORIM, S.A. is a Portuguese company engaged in the production and sale of cork products. The company's main products include cork stoppers for wine, flooring, wall coverings, and insulation materials, with headquarters located in Mozelos, Portugal. Corticeira Amorim is a vertically integrated company, managing the entire cork value chain from forest management to the production of finished goods.
